date_semantics: Each entry updated value is the cited source revision date when published; otherwise it is the verification date.

rating_rubric.0: No reviewed public evidence for this dimension.
rating_rubric.1: Conceptual or incomplete treatment without an executable interoperability contract.
rating_rubric.2: Concrete specification, schema, flow, or project evidence, with material gaps.
rating_rubric.3: Detailed contract plus maintained implementation, test, or operational evidence.
rating_rubric.4: Detailed contract plus multiple independently maintained implementations or externally governed interoperability evidence.
rating_rubric.unknown: Evidence was insufficient to assign a score.

rating_warning: Scores are evidence-maturity assessments by dimension, not a composite quality rank, certification, adoption measure, or statement of protocol priority.
